slider

Slider.

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
min Number 0 No Minimum value.
max Number 100 No Maximum value.
step Number 1 No Length of a step. The value must be greater than 0 and can be exactly divided by the value of max minus min.
disabled Boolean false No Disabled or not.
value Number 0 No Current value.
activeColor String #1aad19 No Selected color.
backgroundColor String #e9e9e9 No Background color.
block-size Number 28 No Size of the sliding block. The value ranges from 12 to 28.
block-color String #ffffff No Color of the sliding block.
show-value Boolean false No Whether to display the current value.
bindchange eventHandle No Event triggered after a sliding. The output is event.detail = {value}.
bindchanging eventHandle No Event triggered during sliding. The output is event.detail = {value}.

示例代码


<view>
  <view>Slider</view>
  <view>
    <view>Setting step</view>
    <view>
      <slider value='5' onChange='slider1change' step='5' />
    </view>
  </view>

  <view>
    <view>Set minimum/maximum value range</view>
    <view>
      <slider value='33' onChange='slider2change' min='25' max='50' show-value />
    </view>
  </view>

  <view>
    <view>Custom style</view>
    <view>
      <slider value='33' onChange='slider3change' min='25' max='50' show-value
              backgroundColor='#FFAA00' activeColor='#00aaee' trackSize='2' handleSize='6' handleColor='blue' />
    </view>
  </view>
</view>

const pageData = {};

for (let i = 1; i < 3; ++i) {
  (function(index) {
    pageData['slider' + index + 'change'] = function(e) {
      console.log('slider' + index + 'A change event occurs, carrying the value:', e.detail.value);
    };
  })(i);
}
Page(pageData);
